### The Hope Diamond’s Two-Day Journey by Mail

In 1958, jeweler Harry Winston donated the 45.5-carat Hope Diamond to the Smithsonian. On November 8, it left New York’s General Post Office in a plain brown package, sent by registered first-class mail. The postage cost $2.44, and registration cost $142.85.

The diamond reached the Smithsonian on November 10. Its arrival was marked by a presentation ceremony attended by Postmaster General Arthur Summerfield.
